summary: Forbright, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its certificate and bylaws in connection with its completed initial public offering on June 12, 2026. The IPO consisted of 7.9 million shares of Class A common stock at $18.00 per share, raising gross proceeds of ~$142.2 million. The amendments were approved prior to the IPO closing. This is a routine post-IPO administrative filing; no special-situation event (merger, tender, activist, etc.) is described. The filing is a standard current report of an IPO completion and corporate governance updates.
